exposure: healthy fetal brain (antenatal MRI showed no cerebral lesions)
outcome: left middle and posterior cerebral artery stroke
cohort: A single female infant born at term via planned cesarean delivery.
finding: This case report describes a unique occurrence of acute neonatal arterial infarction near or during birth following an an elective cesarean delivery in an infant with a previously healthy fetal brain, resulting in lasting hemiparesis.
mod_finding: The report highlights a case of acute neonatal arterial infarction occurring near or during birth following an elective cesarean delivery, in an infant with a previously healthy fetal brain.
